sections.heading: Introduction and Purpose of this Plan

blocks.text: This Medical Surveillance Plan has been prepared by Care Net Consultants (Pty) Ltd for Horizon Construction and Civils (Pty) Ltd. The Plan sets out the occupational risk exposures associated with the Client's business and workforce, the job categories affected, the medical assessments Care Net will perform in respect of each exposure, and the interval at which each assessment will be repeated. It is reviewed annually, or sooner on any material change to operations, plant, materials, workforce composition, legislation, or guidance.

Horizon Construction and Civils (Pty) Ltd operates in Civil engineering works, with approximately 85 employees across 7 job categories, at the following sites: Head office and yard; Project site: N3 interchange upgrade. Building and civil construction contracting.

items: No employees currently work night shifts or rotating shifts that trigger the Code of Good Practice: Arrangement of Working Time medical requirement. This is revisited if night work is introduced.

At an aggregate, job category level, the Client flagged the following categories as possibly including employees with chronic conditions that could cause sudden incapacity: Plant Operator; Driver / Plant and Materials Transport. No individual has been identified to Care Net. The Designated OMP will apply enhanced screening where clinically indicated on an individual basis.

Third party certificate requirement recorded: Principal contractor requires heights fitness certificates valid no longer than 12 months. Incorporated into the applicable category intervals, which are only ever tightened by such requirements.
POPIA: the Client has confirmed employees will be informed of the programme and their rights before first examination, and has elected to use Care Net's standard POPIA notice and consent forms.

sections.heading: Annexure A: Employee to Job Category Register

blocks.text: The register links each employee to a job category and therefore to the OREP and WASP applicable to them. Only the last four digits of each identity number are recorded, in line with Care Net data minimisation practice under POPIA. The register template is issued with this Plan and maintained by the Client SHE or HR representative.

sections.heading: Confidentiality and Protection of Personal Information
Review and Validity of this Plan

blocks.text: This Plan is reviewed by the Designated Occupational Medical Practitioner at least annually, and immediately upon a change in processes, plant, or materials, the introduction of a new job category, a change in applicable legislation or guidance, or notification of an updated risk assessment. In particular, the noise instrument transition of 6 September 2026 is a scheduled review trigger for this Plan.
